title: feat(ui): show the rate and date a home amount was converted at, and a Studio homeAmount editor
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKY5oMZsVopxN5eVhk1kG6N)_

Part-of #27196

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 多币种「本位币金额」字段（`currencyConfig.homeAmount.field`）在记录页和表单分区里改为只读金额，下面一行写明「按汇率 0.1389（2026-11-01）折算」，数据取自记录自己的汇率字段和单据日期字段；同币种记录显示「本位币（汇率 1）」。Studio 字段编辑器在 record 模式下新增三个下拉：本位币金额字段、单据日期、汇率字段，只列规范接受的字段；顺手修了一个缺陷：改选币种代码字段时会把已写的 `homeAmount` 静默删掉。
- **为什么改：** 财务对账要看到折算用的是哪条汇率、哪一天；作者在 Studio 里也要能声明这三个指针。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响声明了 `homeAmount` 的对象：其余币种字段的渲染逐字不变（有对照测试）。新增两个翻译键，属于 widening。回滚即 revert 本 PR。自动布局表单仍然不显示只读字段（含本位币字段），未改。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts`（`homeAmountSourceOf`）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`（`HomeAmountHint`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/CurrencyConfigField.tsx`（`homeAmountCandidates` 与改选币种字段时保留 `homeAmount`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.homeAmount-27196.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中记录页一例断言提示为 "Converted at 0.1389 on Nov 1, 2026"。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（落地前席位欠一次 Clause-② 声明复审）。

## What changes

The ui half of multi-currency M3-2, slice 1 of 2 (Tasks 1 and 3 of the card). The preview (Task 2) is slice 2, waiting on #31609, which moves the engine's conversion functions into a package the ui can import.

**Task 1: the home field reads as what it is.** A `record`-mode amount's `homeAmount.field` is written by the engine alone, and until now nothing in the ui knew a field was one: the declaration sits on the AMOUNT.

- `@object-ui/i18n` gains one reader, `homeAmountSourceOf(fields, name)`: the amount, code field, document date and rate field that name `name` as home. Producers stamp it on the field metadata they hand a currency renderer (`withHomeAmountSource`, read back with `readHomeAmountSource`), the way the form stamps a code field's `usedCurrencyCodes`.
- Producers: the record page (`DetailSection`), the section builder the record dialog and drawer share (`sectionFields.ts`), and an inline `ObjectForm`'s own field build (`ObjectForm.tsx`, added to the claim by amendment 6724257070).
- Consumers: `CurrencyField` draws a stamped field's read face even when the form hands it `disabled` (it was a disabled number box with no symbol), and `CurrencyCellRenderer` adds the same line on the record page. The line is `HomeAmountHint`: "Converted at RATE on DATE" from the record's own `rateField` / `rateDate` values (the rate unrounded, the date with its year), or "In the home currency (rate 1)" when the amount's code is the home currency. Nothing is drawn while the record holds no rate. Nothing is recomputed in the ui.
- Two new locale keys in all eleven packs (`fields.currencyHome.convertedAt`, `fields.currencyHome.homeCurrency`; zh-Hant generated with `gen:zh-hant`) and in `FIELD_DEFAULTS`.

**Task 3: the Studio `homeAmount` editor.** Under `record` mode, `CurrencyConfigField` shows three pickers: home amount field, document date, rate field. `homeAmountCandidates` lists what the spec's object judge (`refuseDishonestHomeAmount`) accepts for each: a stored `dynamic` `currency` field that is `readonly`, has no `expression` and is no other amount's home field; a `date` / `datetime`; a `readonly` `number` with no `expression`, `scale` 12 or none, shared only with an amount on the same code field and document date. The judge exports no predicate, so per the amendment the spec is the test oracle (below), and no refusal text is copied. Unpicking a pointer deletes it, and `homeAmount` goes once none is left. No editor on a `formula` amount, which the spec refuses `homeAmount` on.

**Defect fixed in Task 3.** Re-picking an amount's currency code field committed `{ currencyMode: 'record', currencyField }` and silently deleted an authored `homeAmount`. It is now kept; leaving `record` mode still drops it, as the spec requires.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe('home field faces (ADR-0144 D5)')`: the reader and the no-stamp identity; the form widget draws no input and the line "Converted at 0.1389 on Nov 1, 2026"; the cell says the same, and "In the home currency (rate 1)" for a same-currency row; no rate ⇒ no line. CONTROL: an unstamped readonly amount stays an input in the form and a bare cell.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/sectionFormHomeAmount-27196.test.tsx`: the record dialog (edit and view), the drawer and an inline `ObjectForm`, each with authored sections, draw the home field with its line and no input. CONTROL: a readonly currency field no amount names stays the disabled box.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.homeAmount-27196.test.tsx`: the record page's home row carries the line, and only that row; rate 1 case.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe('Studio homeAmount editor (ADR-0144 D5)')`:
  - candidate lists, the rate field judged against the picked document date and code field;
  - **ORACLE, offered ⇒ parses:** every field × document date × rate field the editor offers on the fixture object parses through `ObjectSchema` (10 combinations);
  - **ORACLE, left out ⇒ refused:** a writable, an `expression`, a `fixed`-mode and an already-claimed home field, a `scale: 2` and a writable rate field, a rate field shared across document dates, a text document date and a `formula` amount are each refused at a `homeAmount` path (no message asserted);
  - picking the three pointers writes `homeAmount` and the object parses; re-picking the code field keeps `homeAmount`; switching to `dynamic` drops it; no editor under `dynamic` or on a `formula` amount. CONTROL: the five existing cases in the file stay green.
  - The file now loads `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` at module top: editing it put it under `check:test-source-alias`'s source-reach half, which found both reached through the inspector's CEL authoring.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, kept as today (amendment 6724151062):** an auto-layout `ObjectForm` keeps dropping every `readonly` field (`plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`, `filterSystemFields`), the home field included. Changing that would move every readonly field on every auto form. The home field shows on the record page and on authored sections.
- The display trusts the stored rate and date; it never recomputes. The live preview before save is slice 2 (`Blocked-by: #31609`); its refused-read (403) state is still NOT MEASURED live and is owed there.
- The hint's date is the document-date field's own value, formatted as a date. For a `datetime` document date the engine takes the calendar day in `localization.timezone`; the display formats the instant in the display time zone, which the Console sets from the same setting.

## Verification

Head `68f353bae4e9ac4082d9aa91ac0bdf156bab698c` (origin/main `69244406` merged in; no file on this PR changed on main in between). 28 files, +700 / −11.

- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reports 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; every recorded exit code is 0.
- **Package suites** (all exit 0, under the verify lock):
  - `@object-ui/i18n`: 99 files passed; 1804 tests passed, 13 skipped.
  - `@object-ui/fields`: 300 files passed, 1 skipped; 4548 tests passed, 7 skipped.
  - `@object-ui/plugin-form`: 226 files passed; 2465 tests passed, 1 skipped.
  - `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: 374 files passed, 1 skipped; 3355 tests passed, 18 skipped.
  - app-shell, narrowed to the 54 files naming `CurrencyConfigField` or `ObjectFieldInspector`: 54 files and 578 tests passed. The rest of app-shell was not run locally.
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 170 files passed, 2 skipped; 5002 tests passed, 2 skipped.
- **Ablations** (`ablation-replace.mjs`; each one restored to a blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  1. `readHomeAmountSource` returns `undefined`: 9 of 22 display pins red, across the fields, plugin-form and plugin-detail files.
  2. The rate-field filter keeps only the `number` type test (no readonly, expression or sharing check): 2 of 13 Studio pins red.
  3. Re-picking the code field drops `homeAmount` again: 1 of 13 Studio pins red.
